task.text: I have a bag with 12 slips of paper. Some have a 2 on them, and the rest have a 7. If the expected value of a randomly drawn slip is 3.25, how many of the slips have a 2?
task.original_text: Suppose I have a bag with 12 slips of paper in it.  Some of the slips have a 2 on them, and the rest have a 7 on them.  If the expected value of the number shown on a slip randomly drawn from the bag is $3.25$, then how many slips have a 2?
